summary: Objective budget burns and exhausted budgets open one native episode for the declared owning agent; unknown evidence cannot manufacture recovery

replay.detail: Existing objective failure and recovery claims remain authoritative.

schema.detail: New objective failures include an objective field identifying their exact declaring objective. Existing failure and recovery claims remain valid; no client wire types change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: The existing objective response path accepts burning and exhausted alongside legacy missed. A transition between burn and exhaustion keeps the same episode; only measured met evidence or removal of an exactly owned child recovers it. No-data, not-eligible and no-qualifying-events preserve an open episode. Native binding ownership survives source revisions and member restart without prefix-cleaning independent declarations. Faults remain agent-addressed, not person notifications.

manual.detail: Declare an on-breach owner to receive objective episodes.

recovery.detail: Rollback stops opening episodes for the new budget statuses without discarding existing claims.
